field_rules.family: non-empty strategy family such as variance-alpha, hedger-benchmark, smile-forecast-research, or signal-component
field_rules.hedger: hedger identifier or research-only/not-wired for non-tradable components
field_rules.expected_edge: plain-language hypothesis for why the strategy should earn or preserve edge
field_rules.current_status: implementation status used for roadmap triage
field_rules.replay_command: command or research command that validates the strategy/component
field_rules.known_risks: non-empty list of model, data, execution, or interpretation risks
